messages:
maria: Hey team — opened a PR to tighten wording around rate limits, tiered quotas, and burst credit behavior. Also added an example SDK snippet for checking quota before a big batch job. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
kevin: thanks — quick skim looks good. small ask: can we avoid saying 'unlimited burst' anywhere? that's confusing for sales. maybe 'temporary burst allowance' instead.
sanjay: I noticed the math example on line 84 is off for tiered billing (we double counted min tier). I'll paste a corrected snippet shortly.
olivia: also saw a broken dashboard link under "Usage analytics" heading — CI flagged it. docs-bot, can you paste the failing URL?
docs-bot: CI link-checker: broken link at line 110 -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/old-metering-panel (404)
maria: thanks bot — replaced with https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/metering-v2 in the PR. also added a short note about panel name changes in the migration guide.
lisa: for the SDK example can we include both Python and Node, quick one-liners for quota check? ops folks love copy/paste.
maria: good call. added two snippets. Python one-liner:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
status = client.quota.check(customer_id='acct_123')
print(status.remaining_tokens)
```
kevin: can we add a short note on eventual consistency for quota endpoints? customers were tripped on that before.
maria: added a sentence: 'Quota status may be eventually consistent up to 30s for cross-region syncs.' PTAL.
sanjay: here is my corrected billing math (replaces existing paragraph):
```text
Example: tier A -> first 100k tokens at $0.004, tier B -> next 400k tokens at $0.0025. For a 450k token month, cost = 100k*0.004 + 350k*0.0025 = $400 + $875 = $1,275
```
olivia: lgtm, small grammar nit at line 92 (missing article).
maria: fixed grammar and pushed.
kevin: re: dashboards, can you include the JSON payload for the new panel so customers can import?
maria: added panel export blob and a short import command. e.g. curl import example:
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/panels/import -d @metering-panel.json
```
lisa: approving once CI passes. thanks for handling the broken link + billing correction. :tada:
maria: thanks all — merging after green CI. I'll follow up in release notes about the 'temporary burst allowance' wording change.
